name: 涟漪 (Ripple) v0.1.9
body:
## 更新内容 / What's New
- 视频号和朋友圈可以先给几分钟再拦。打开应用内拦截后，点开这一项就能改成「先给几分钟」，默认 10 分钟。时间用完后写一条理由，可以再刷 5 分钟，每天最多 3 次。开着严格模式时，要输入亲友解锁码才能续。这些时间都算进微信的每日时长。
- 各处设时长的地方都加了「自定义」，用滚轮按 1 分钟调。每日时长可以设 1 分钟到 12 小时，连续使用和中间休息可以设 1 到 60 分钟，休息最短 3 分钟。一键专注也改成按 1 分钟调，最短还是 15 分钟。
- 修好了小米和 HyperOS 手机上抖音、B 站等 App 拦不住的问题。拦截页弹不出来时，涟漪会先回到桌面，再盖一层提示。建议在「设置 → 应用设置 → 应用管理 → 涟漪 → 其他权限」里把「后台弹出界面」设为允许，拦截页就能正常弹出来。
- OPPO 小窗里打开被拦的 App，现在会被一层遮罩盖住，视频声音也会停下。小窗本身需要你自己关掉。同一次打开只记一次，拦截页上「今晚第几次打开」不会再越加越多。
- 首页 App 图标偶尔显示成字母的问题修好了，应用内拦截说明条的底色也改回了浅色。
- 这次只更新安卓版，iPhone 版还是 v0.1.5，上面这些新功能目前只有安卓有。
- WeChat Channels and Moments can now give you a few minutes before blocking. Tap an enabled in-app block and choose a time allowance, 10 minutes by default. When it runs out, write a reason to get 5 more minutes, up to 3 times a day. In strict mode an unlock code is needed instead. This time counts toward WeChat's daily limit.
- Every time setting now has a Custom option with a wheel in 1 minute steps. Daily limits go from 1 minute to 12 hours, usage and break lengths from 1 to 60 minutes with breaks at least 3 minutes. Quick focus now also moves in 1 minute steps, still 15 minutes minimum.
- Fixed blocking on Xiaomi and HyperOS phones, where apps like Douyin and Bilibili could still be used. If the block screen cannot appear, Ripple goes to the home screen and shows a notice on top. Allowing "Display pop-up windows while running in the background" for Ripple makes the block screen appear normally.
- On OPPO phones, a blocked app opened in a floating window is now covered and its sound stops. You still need to close the floating window yourself. One attempt counts as one open, so the open count on the block screen no longer keeps climbing.
- Fixed app icons sometimes showing as a letter on the home screen, and the in-app block note is back to its light background.
- This update is for Android only. The iPhone version stays at v0.1.5, and these new features are Android only for now.
